crossRefs.note: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
The angel who talked with me came again, and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.
He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top…

translations.web: On this I awakened, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me.
translations.bsb: At this I awoke and looked around. My sleep had been most pleasant to me.
translations.kjv: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet
translations.asv: Upon this I awaked, and beheld; and my sleep was sweet unto me.
